arxiv-2102-00396.title: THE DISTANCE BETWEEN THE WEIGHTS OF THE NEURAL NETWORK IS MEANINGFUL
arxiv-2102-00396.creator: Liqun Yang Yijun Yang Yao Wang Zhenyu Yang Wei Zeng
arxiv-2102-00396.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Liqun Yang Yijun Yang Yao Wang Zhenyu Yang Wei Zeng. In the application of neural networks, we need to select a suitable model based on the problem complexity and the dataset scale. To analyze the network’s capacity, quantifying the information learned by the network is necessary. This paper proves that the distance between the neural network weights in different training stages can be used to estimate the information accumulated by the network in the training process directly.

arxiv-2106-04190.title: Glauber gluons in annihilation amplitudes for heavy meson decays
arxiv-2106-04190.creator: Hsiang-nan Li 1
arxiv-2106-04190.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Hsiang-nan Li 1. We investigate the Glauber divergences in nonfactorizable annihilation amplitudes for two-body hadronic heavy meson decays in the k T k_{T} factorization theorem at one-loop level. These divergences can be absorbed into the Glauber factors in the dominant kinematic regions of small parton momenta, which modify the interference between a nonfactorizable annihilation amplitude and other amplitudes by rotating it with a phase.

arxiv-2112-13298.description:
A 2021 arXiv research paper by Zinovy Reichstein, Federico Scavia. Let G G be a linear algebraic group over a field. We show that, under mild assumptions, in a family of primitive generically free G G -varieties over a base variety B B the essential dimension of the geometric fibers may drop on a countable union of Zariski closed subsets of B B and stays constant away from this countable union. We give several applications of this result. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification

arxiv-2310-16789.title: Detecting Pretraining Data from Large Language Models
arxiv-2310-16789.creator: Weijia Shi, Anirudh Ajith, Mengzhou Xia, Yangsibo Huang, Daogao Liu, Terra Blevins, Danqi Chen, Luke Zettlemoyer
arxiv-2310-16789.description: Abstract Although large language models (LLMs) are widely deployed, the data used to train them is rarely disclosed. Given the incredible scale of this data, up to trillions of tokens, it is all but certain that it includes potentially problematic text such as copyrighted materials, personally identifiable information, and test data for widely reported reference benchmarks.

arxiv-2505-00913.title: Fine-Tuning without Performance Degradation
arxiv-2505-00913.creator: Han Wang, Adam White, Martha White
arxiv-2505-00913.description: Abstract Fine-tuning policies learned offline remains a major challenge in application domains. Monotonic performance improvement during fine-tuning is often challenging, as agents typically experience performance degradation at the early fine-tuning stage. The community has identified multiple difficulties in fine-tuning a learned network online, however, the majority of progress has focused on improving learning efficiency during fine-tuning.

arxiv-2507-22133.title: Prompt Optimization and Evaluation for LLM Automated Red Teaming
arxiv-2507-22133.creator: Michael Freenor, Lauren Alvarez, Milton Leal, Lily Smith, Joel Garrett, Yelyzaveta Husieva, Madeline Woodruff, Ryan Miller, Erich Kummerfeld, Rafael Medeiros, Sander Schulhoff, [1ex] Fuel iX Applied Research, Charlottesville, USA
arxiv-2507-22133.description: Abstract Applications that use Large Language Models (LLMs) are becoming widespread, making the identification of system vulnerabilities increasingly important. Automated Red Teaming accelerates this effort by using an LLM to generate and execute attacks against target systems. Attack generators are evaluated using the Attack Success Rate (ASR) – the sample mean calculated over the judgment of success for each attack.

arxiv-2508-16177.title: Proportional Representation in Rank Aggregation
arxiv-2508-16177.creator: Patrick Lederer p.lederer@unsw.edu.au UNSW Sydney
arxiv-2508-16177.description: Abstract In rank aggregation, the task is to aggregate multiple weighted input rankings into a single output ranking. While numerous methods, so-called social welfare functions (SWFs), have been suggested for this problem, all of the classical SWFs tend to be majoritarian and are thus not acceptable when a proportional ranking is required.

arxiv-2512-09280.title: A Modular Lean 4 Framework for Confluence and Strong Normalization of Lambda Calculi with Products and Sums
arxiv-2512-09280.creator: Arthur F. Ramos, Anjolina G. de Oliveira, Ruy J. G. B. de Queiroz, Tiago M. L. de Veras
arxiv-2512-09280.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Arthur F. Ramos, Anjolina G. de Oliveira, Ruy J. G. B. de Queiroz, Tiago M. L. de Veras. We present Metatheory , a comprehensive library for programming language foundations in Lean 4, featuring a modular framework for proving confluence of abstract rewriting systems.

arxiv-2601-04396.title: Inference in the presence of model-form uncertainties: Leveraging a prediction-oriented approach to improve uncertainty characterization
arxiv-2601-04396.creator: Rebekah White, Rileigh Bandy, & Teresa Portone
arxiv-2601-04396.description: Abstract Bayesian inference is a popular approach to calibrating uncertainties, but it can underpredict such uncertainties when model misspecification is present, impacting its reliability to inform decision making. Recently, the statistics and machine learning communities have developed prediction-oriented inference approaches that provide better calibrated uncertainties and adapt to the level of misspecification present.

pmc-10728257.creator: Mads Lawaetz, Tina Binderup, Anders Christensen, Karina Juhl, Giedrius Lelkaitis, Eva Lykke, Line Knudsen, Christian von Buchwald, Andreas Kjaer
pmc-10728257.description: Purpose[64Cu]Cu-DOTA-AE105 urokinase-type plasminogen activator receptor (uPAR)-PET/CT is a novel and promising imaging modality for cancer visualization, although it has not been tested in head and neck cancer patients nor in preclinical models that closely resemble these heterogenous tumors, i.e., patient-derived xenograft (PDX) models.

pmc-10731336.title: The stage-dependent prognostic role of ARID1A in hepatocellular carcinoma
pmc-10731336.creator: Hai Zhou, Dantong Sun, Chunxiao Miao, Junyan Tao, Chao Ge, Taoyang Chen, Hong Li, Helei Hou
pmc-10731336.description: BackgroundHepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is one of the most common causes of cancer-related death. Although novel treatment currently achieves a better response, the majority of HCC patients develop resistance and cannot benefit. Hence, novel biomarkers for guiding therapy and predicting the prognosis are needed.MethodsTissue microarrays of 206 HCC patients were used, and ARID1A expression was determined by immunohistochemistry.

pmc-11404035.title: Clinical characteristics and risk factors of severe COVID-19 in hospitalized neonates with omicron variant infection: a retrospective study
pmc-11404035.creator: Huijing Wei, Fu Wei, Xiaokang Peng, Pan Liu, Li Tang, Yishan Liu, Shan Liao, Yajing Bo, Yuzhen Zhao, Ruina Li, Xiaoguai Liu, Fanpu Ji
pmc-11404035.description: BackgroundReports on coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) in neonates are limited, especially in patients infected with severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-COV-2) Omicron variant. This study aims to analyze the clinical characteristics and identify risk factors associated with severe COVID-19 in neonates infected with Omicron variant.

pmc-12639834.title: Chick embryo development assessment and fertility detection using pixel-wise hyperspectral image analysis and deep learning
pmc-12639834.creator: Mahdi Ghaderi, Seyed Ahmad Mireei, Aminollah Masoumi, Mohammad Sedghi, Majid Nazeri
pmc-12639834.description: Accurate early detection of fertility and embryonic development during incubation is essential for enhancing hatchability efficiency in poultry production. This study employed a line-scan hyperspectral imaging (HSI) system to monitor fertility and embryonic development in white-shelled eggs. Full-transmittance hyperspectral images were acquired at the end of each of the first four incubation days from both fertile and infertile eggs.

pmc-12657016.title: Lactobacillus reuteri-derived HDCA suppresses PEDV replication while alleviating virus-triggered inflammation in piglets
pmc-12657016.creator: Zhibiao Bian, Qianqian Li, Hongchao Gou, Yan Li, Zhiyong Jiang, Pinpin Chu, Shaolun Zhai, Huahua Kang, Chunling Li, Guanghui Zhao
pmc-12657016.description: BackgroundPorcine epidemic diarrhea virus (PEDV) causes severe diarrhea, vomiting, and high mortality in neonatal piglets, but no fully effective treatments or vaccines are currently available. Although gut microbiota transplantation can alleviate post infection symptoms, the specific protective bacterial strains or metabolites involved, along with their underlying mechanisms of action against PEDV, remain unclear.ResultsOral administration of L.

pmc-12662085.title: Protocol for autofluorescence removal in microglia by photobleaching in free-floating immunofluorescent staining of mouse brain tissue
pmc-12662085.creator: Mark N Metri, Justin You, Jeehye Park
pmc-12662085.description: SummaryAutofluorescence in brain tissue poses a challenge in immunofluorescent staining by obscuring antibody-labeled proteins, mainly within microglia. Here, we describe a cost-effective protocol for removing autofluorescence in mouse brain sections by photobleaching. We outline steps to collect and section brain tissue, apply a photobleaching step using a light-emitting diode (LED), and perform immunofluorescent staining with primary and secondary antibodies.

pmc-12738593.title: Comparison of contamination by polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons, pesticides and pharmaceuticals in abandoned meanders and channel bars, Czech Republic
pmc-12738593.creator: Jan Sedláček, Jitka Tolaszová, Zuzana Lenďáková, Ondřej Bábek, Ondřej Koukal, Lukáš Maloušek
pmc-12738593.description: This article focuses on the necessity to enhance the current understanding of the accumulation and fate of pesticides and pharmaceuticals (emerging pollutants) in abandoned meanders and adjacent river channel bars. The primary objective of this study is to conduct a comparative analysis of pollutant concentrations in both settings and to identify the driving factors of their deposition.

pmc-12772973.title: Stepwise improvement in intracerebral haematoma expansion prediction with advanced imaging: a comprehensive comparison of existing scores
pmc-12772973.creator: Umberto Pensato, Koji Tanaka, Chitapa Kaveeta, Johanna Ospel, MacKenzie Horn, David Rodriguez-Luna, Nishita Singh, Ankur Banerjee, Sanchea Wasyliw, Kennedy Horn, Amy Bobyn, Anneliese Neweduk, Wu Qiu, Mayank Goyal, Bijoy Menon, Andrew Demchuk
pmc-12772973.description: BackgroundWe aim to comprehensively assess and compare the predictive performance of haematoma expansion (HE) scores in a homogeneous cohort of acute intracerebral haemorrhage (ICH) patients.MethodsExisting scores for predicting HE in acute ICH patients were included and categorised by imaging modality: non-contrast CT (NCCT), single-phase CT angiography (sCTA) and multiphase CTA (mCTA).

pmc-13471587.title: Prediction of myelosuppression in cervical cancer after concurrent chemoradiotherapy by CT radiomics-based model
pmc-13471587.creator: Chen Sun, Alan Chu, Shijia Liu, Rui Song, Jinghui Yang, Xiao Liu, Lanlan Gan, Yongtai Wang, Zongwen Liu, Xin Wang, Mengxi Li
pmc-13471587.description: BackgroundConcurrent chemoradiotherapy (CCRT) was highly effective in treating cervical cancer (CC) but raised the risk of bone marrow suppression. However, models to predict the risk of myelosuppression in CC patients after CCRT based on computed tomography (CT) imaging histology are immature.MethodsThe Region of interest (ROI) of the CT images was segmented, and radiomic features were extracted.

pmc-13679996.title: Safety and Effectiveness of Bupropion for Smoking Cessation During Pregnancy: A Scoping Review
pmc-13679996.creator: George R Habib, Priyanka Ramanathan, Gabriella Garas, Alexander Knight
pmc-13679996.description: Smoking during pregnancy is associated with adverse maternal, fetal, and neonatal outcomes. Although behavioral counseling remains first-line treatment, pharmacotherapy may be considered when counseling alone is insufficient. This scoping review mapped the available evidence on the safety and effectiveness of bupropion for smoking cessation during pregnancy.
